ACTION: Run `tests/test_retry.py`, then the full suite, and confirm both pass (green).

Message to partner:

I will fix F1 myself, as you asked. First I check the line in `fetch/retry.py`, because the right operator depends on how `attempt` is counted. The existing test only checks that a retry happens, so I add a test for the exact retry count and watch it fail before the one-character change.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- A test that asserts "a retry happens" passes for any `max_retries` above 0, so it cannot catch an off-by-one error.
- `>` and `>=` differ only when `attempt` equals `max_retries`. That single value is the case the new test must pin.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

I still send a scoped re-review to a Sonnet reviewer. You waived the fix subagent, and nobody else has seen this change yet. It reviews one small diff, so it costs little.
